The '''Fegorosk system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Obtrexta sector/Legends|Obtrexta sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the planet [[Fegorosk IV]], known for its [[swuvehorn]] clubs.
